name: pc20-feed-validator
summary: A page that checks a podcast RSS feed against twenty Podcasting 2.0 namespace tags and reports what is present, missing or malformed.
caveats: Client-side fetch, so feeds without permissive CORS headers fail with a network error. Route through a guarded server proxy if you need those; see the image-proxy recipe's proxy-guard.ts.
Validates tag presence and shape, not correctness. A well-formed but wrong podcast:guid passes.
